body.title: Add the entry definitions
body.summary: Add the entries module with EntryKind, EntryStatus, ProjectId, Source, Provenance, NamedEntity and Entry, its 500-character limit and retire, with the tests for the acceptance criteria.
acceptanceChecks: Entry kind and status values equal the contract strings
Empty kind or project, wrong types, empty sources and mismatched tags are rejected naming the field
Text of 501 characters is rejected and 500 is accepted; text is kept exactly
Tags after non-Latin text or emoji and a name tagged twice are accepted
retire changes the same entry once and records the time, with or without a replacement; a failed retire changes nothing
A retired entry needs a retirement time and may be created directly; an active entry has no time or replacement
Direct field assignment is rejected; entries compare by value before and after retirement and are not hashable
A source has only agent, session, file, position and time

tests.name: tests/test_entries.py: an entry with an empty kind raises an invalid_input failure naming kind
tests/test_entries.py: an entry with an empty project raises an invalid_input failure naming project
tests/test_entries.py: retire changes the same entry and records the time, with and without a replacement
tests/test_entries.py: retiring a retired entry fails and leaves it unchanged
tests/test_entries.py: retire with an invalid time fails and leaves the entry active
tests/test_entries.py: a retired entry needs a retirement time and an active entry has none
tests/test_entries.py: assigning a field of an entry directly is rejected
tests/test_entries.py: entry text with a negation, a scope and surrounding spaces is kept exactly
tests/test_entries.py: a source has only agent, session, file, position and time
tests/test_entries.py: text of 501 characters raises an invalid_input failure naming text and text of 500 is accepted
tests/test_entries.py: an entity that differs from the text at its positions raises an invalid_input failure naming entities
tests/test_entries.py: tags after non-Latin text or emoji and repeated names are accepted
tests/test_entries.py: wrong types and invalid source, provenance and project values are rejected naming the field
tests/test_entries.py: entry kind and status values equal the contract
tests/test_entries.py: entries compare by value and are not hashable
